name: SSRTVD
definition: SSRTVD is the first GAN-based spatial SR for time-varying data. It pairs a densely connected generator with dual discriminators: a spatial discriminator for per-volume realism and a temporal discriminator operating on triplets of consecutive volumes to enforce coherence across timesteps.
summary: SSRTVD is the first GAN for spatial super-resolution of time-varying volumetric data, distinguished by a temporal discriminator that enforces frame-to-frame coherence using advection-aligned constraints.
